label: AIA (Anisotropic Information Architecture)
family: VII · Flow-Core / Portable AIA / pedagogic control

record.category: VII · Flow-Core / Portable AIA / pedagogic control
record.description: TD613 information architecture in which legibility and lawful access depend on time, route, modality and scale. Four non-equivalent receiver projections preserve governed invariants. Portable Loom adapters implement particular transport and return functions within this architecture.

record.note: The original AIA specification includes time, route, modality and scale. Portable Loom adapters implement particular transport and return functions within this architecture.
